baseline: Current project ArtStyle palette and existing modular building workflow
rules: Use the existing project ArtStyle palette for buildings, terrain, props and vegetation.
Preserve authored modular proportions, UV atlas regions and open-door collision.
Convert selected UE/Blender assets offline; share textures and compress runtime resources.
Keep source archives under .gdignore; never auto-extract at game startup.
Do not change grass density, height, spacing or geometry generation during resource removal.
